qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Integrated bank-insurance model yields sticky primary-bank relationships, cross-selling advantages, and low-cost deposit funding in concentrated Belgian and Czech duopolies; low cost-to-income (~45%) and sustained 14-16% ROE prove structural moat.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Balance Sheet, REJECT). Integrated Belgian bank-insurance leader with outstanding cost efficiency (cost-to-income ~45%), leading digital distribution (Kate), and disciplined capital returns (14-15% ROE). However, as a commercial fractional-reserve bank operating with 10-15x leverage on tangible equity, credit risk, and deposit duration mismatch, it fails the Munger peace-of-mind balance sheet standard.
qualitative.evidence: FY2024-2025 ROE reached 14-15% with Net Profit of €3.4B-€3.6B and CET1 ratio of 14.9% (Basel IV). Solvency II ratio for insurance operations stands at 227%. However, total balance sheet leverage exceeds 12x assets-to-equity (€27.3B long-term debt, €34.0B cash, €350B+ total assets), exposing equity to systemic credit cycles, deposit run dynamics, and regulatory liquidity mandates. Fails Gate 6 commercial bank standard.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
